title: Sovereign AX model gateway request bodies v1 (normative)
description: v1.3 (B-20, B-21, B-18, B/C-01, B/C-02). Single normative source for the client->gateway request bodies of POST /v1/decide and POST /v1/respond. D03, D04 §7, D09 §3 and D12 only cite this file. Headers (not in body): Authorization: Bearer <account token>, X-Device-Id. Any field outside this schema => 400 gateway.param_rejected, and 400/409 response bodies never echo the input (codes only). Gateway-side rules that a schema cannot express: (1) /v1/decide `input` UTF-8 byte length <= that bundle's maxInputBytes; (2) bundleId@digest must be in the gateway's bundle set (409 gateway.digest_mismatch; detects deployment mismatch only, not integrity — the engine recomputes outcomes from its local, app-embedded bundle definition, C-24); (3) model, effort, max_output_tokens, tools, text.format, store:false, safety_identifier and prompt_cache_options are fixed per bundle/toolset by the gateway, never by the client; (4) prompt_cache_key = 'acct:' + HMAC(server_secret, accountId) + ':b:' + bundleId (or ':t:' + toolset), account-isolated; (5) per-run budget is enforced through the gateway-signed runToken (L1 <= 12, L2 <= 2); (6) second PII tripwire in memory (resident registration no., business registration no., card, account patterns) => 400 gateway.pii_tripwire, count only, body never stored; (7) Phase 1: no image input of any kind (GW_ALLOW_IMAGES=false). BYOK adapters run the same schema, budget, tripwire and app-embedded bundle-digest checks locally before calling the provider (B-21).

runToken.description: Gateway-issued, gateway-signed run token. Calls outside a playbook run (chat, intent_fill, query_parse) use a runToken issued per chatSessionId with its own budget.

input.description: Redacted screen text only (D06). Byte length <= bundle maxInputBytes (<= 16384).

replay.description: Earlier response output items carrying the gateway tag HMAC(gw_key, accountId||runToken||item), and function_call_output items answering a tagged call_id. Untagged or mismatching items => 400.
